candidate.definition_en: Relating to the nucleus of an atom or cell; relating to nuclear energy or weapons.
candidate.explanation_ar: نووي، متعلق بالطاقة النووية أو النواة.

senses.definition_en: Relating to energy produced by atomic reactions or weapons using this energy.
senses.definition_ar: نووي؛ متعلق بالطاقة الذرية أو الأسلحة النووية.

senses.definition_en: Relating to the nucleus of an atom or a biological cell.
senses.definition_ar: متعلق بنواة الذرة أو نواة الخلية.

senses.definition_en: Forming a basic social unit consisting of parents and their children (nuclear family).
senses.definition_ar: مرتبط بالأسرة النواة المكونة من الوالدين وأبنائهما.

examples: Many countries rely on nuclear power to generate electricity.
The government signed a treaty to limit the spread of nuclear weapons.
A traditional nuclear family consists of parents and their children.
